findings.title: Category subpages are absent
findings.observation: The snapshot has one flat rings.html page and no category subpages.
findings.requested_disposition: Add category indexes/pages or publish the unmet requirement as an open gap; do not claim a complete categorized catalog.
findings.resolution: The integrated root dashboard added five category pages at 7a894ed; the original flat legacy snapshot remains historical.

findings.title: Checklist narrows ring weight to metal-only weight
findings.observation: The generated checklist replaces the requested ring weight in grams with gold-alloy weight excluding stones/components.
findings.requested_disposition: Keep ring weight and gold-alloy-only weight as separate, explicitly labeled official-evidence fields; never derive one from the other.

findings.title: Calculator UI has no usable verified inputs
findings.observation: Both selectable products have null weight and null gold-price inputs; no user-input path exists, so every UI calculation remains blank.
findings.requested_disposition: Add labeled user-input controls and unit/source/date handling without presenting user input as an official observation; retain blank outputs for missing inputs.
findings.resolution: The integrated root calculator added user-controlled weight, karat, spot and ask inputs at 7a894ed. New input-validation and labeling risks are tracked separately as R6-07.

findings.title: Audit does not validate every populated product claim
findings.observation: The audit checks source host plus price/metal/ID excerpts, but not name/category/karat/priceScope evidence; an allowlisted non-product URL can satisfy the generic row-link check.
findings.requested_disposition: Require field-level evidence and product-specific URLs, remove hard-coded review-date acceptance, and add negative tests for unsupported edits.

findings.title: Workflow actions use mutable major-version tags
findings.observation: The reviewed workflow references GitHub actions by major-version tags rather than full commit SHAs. The later main workflow removed deploy-pages but retains tag-pinned checkout/setup/upload actions.
findings.requested_disposition: Pin third-party workflow dependencies to reviewed full commit SHAs.

findings.title: Small eyebrow text is below WCAG AA contrast
findings.observation: The 10px #aa8135 eyebrow text measures approximately 3.3096:1 on #f7f7f1 and 3.5589:1 on white; ordinary text requires 4.5:1.
findings.requested_disposition: Darken the small text or otherwise meet at least 4.5:1 without rounding up to the threshold.

findings.title: Four Zales rows publish unsupported yellow-gold fields
findings.observation: Official Zales titles support 10K Gold but not Yellow for four rows; the data populates 10K Yellow Gold and Yellow.
findings.requested_disposition: Blank unsupported color and narrow metal wording unless official yellow-gold text is retrieved and quoted.

findings.title: Some identifiers and product notes are URL-derived or unquoted
findings.observation: VRAI and four Zales SKU displays lack direct SKU/style quotes; one Zales note asserts round constituent stones without retrieved support.
findings.requested_disposition: Label URL identifiers as such or blank them; remove or officially support product notes; include these fields in QA.

findings.title: Solid-gold and verification language exceeds the evidence
findings.observation: BN-194548 asserts a solid-alloy conclusion despite solid_gold_explicit false, and generated metadata says Verified solid-gold although all rows lack explicit target-product support.
findings.requested_disposition: Remove unsupported solid claims, narrow metadata, and keep independent professional purity testing mandatory.

findings.title: Blanket card-acceptance statement is contradicted by official pages
findings.observation: F-012 and the landing page say no captured page states card acceptance, while official Blue Nile product pages explicitly offer the Blue Nile Credit Card.
findings.requested_disposition: Record the exact scoped card offer; leave other networks/retailers unverified and do not infer protection outcomes.

findings.title: Policy and contact evidence is incomplete or mismatched
findings.observation: VRAI omits sourced fees/eligibility/exclusions; Brilliant Earth omits an official 30-day policy and its contact_source_url does not support the recorded localized product-header phone.
findings.requested_disposition: Retrieve and quote official policy/contact evidence with region and scope; correct the landing claim that exclusions are recorded per retailer.

findings.title: VRAI size-specific weight loses context in category tables
findings.observation: The official source and weight_basis say 2.86 g at size 6, but the builder does not render weight_basis.
findings.requested_disposition: Display the size/variant beside every weight and item-specific calculation.

findings.title: Calculator accepts risky weight basis, ambiguous currency, and nonfinite input
findings.observation: Ring weight is not labeled metal-only; asking price has no currency; actual execution with Infinity produced Infinity g and $∞.
findings.requested_disposition: Require finite positive metal-only weight and explicit ask currency; show validation errors and blank outputs; add negative tests.

findings.title: Retail and scrap rules lack authoritative sources
findings.observation: The calculator gives 2x normal-retail, 1.05x warning, 1.0x scrap, and melt-floor generalizations without dated authoritative support.
findings.requested_disposition: Remove or authoritatively source and scope these claims; distinguish theoretical spot arithmetic from actual transactions.

findings.title: QA PASS has material false-negative paths
findings.observation: Shared-file substring checks do not map every field to item-specific evidence and miss unsupported colors, identifiers, notes, policy summaries, and some blank flags.
findings.requested_disposition: Use item-scoped field-level evidence and mutation tests; narrow report claims and retain independent official-source review after PASS.

findings.title: Published narrative contains stale or overbroad claims
findings.observation: At main 966e87b, F-015 still says 8 Blue Nile rows after integration to 10; F-001 makes a whole-page absence claim contradicted by unrelated VRAI text; absolute no-invention language exceeds QA scope. Earlier QA-badge and Flagged-page hard-coded counts were fixed in 7a894ed and 966e87b respectively. The landing says all three evidence gaps affect every row even though VRAI has a published weight.
findings.requested_disposition: Derive counts, narrow absence claims to target-product evidence, and publish precise limitations/open findings.

findings.title: Seller reputation and purchase documentation are not independently assessed
findings.observation: README calls sellers reputable without independent reputation evidence; the buyer records checklist omits invoice, replies, marks, certificates, and test report.
findings.requested_disposition: Assess reputation with appropriate independent evidence or mark it unassessed; add a purchase-documentation checklist.

findings.title: One archived Zales excerpt is not currently reproducible verbatim
findings.observation: Z-20301172 numbers match, but the independent current retrieval omits the archived Discounted Price and Original Price labels.
findings.requested_disposition: Preserve timestamped raw evidence or refresh exact excerpt wording and disclose extraction changes.

findings.title: Gold quote number was updated but assigned the retrieval date
findings.observation: Main fc2a882 records 4,028.53 with quote_date 2026-10-22, while the independently retrieved official page and its own archived excerpt say Data as of 21 October, 2026. retrieved_at 2026-10-22 is separately correct; arithmetic at the new number passes.
findings.requested_disposition: Set quote_date and generated date labels back to 2026-10-21 unless the official as-of date changes; retain the supported numeric quote, rebuild, and rerun official-source and hallucination/security checks.

findings.title: Post-merge review report contained transcription errata
findings.observation: Live/self-consistency review of merge 73a98fe found report-only errors for five Blue Nile widths and three source URLs, plus unrelated prong/pavé wording. Direct official re-fetch confirmed the implementation data; the errors were in the review prose.
findings.requested_disposition: Correct the report, retain the pre-errata audit output, and run item-row report consistency checks after every review edit.
findings.resolution: Corrected in the follow-up review branch. reviews/pr8-73a98fe-pre-errata-checks.txt retains the 39-flag pre-errata result; reviews/final-post-errata-checks.txt returns to the 31 implementation findings with six arithmetic controls and no report-row mismatches.

review_pass_policy: After every disposition or content edit, repeat official-source comparison, hallucination/security checks, build/link checks, and manual review of unresolved flags.
